title: ComfortLease Collections Timeline: Grace Period, Late Fee, Past Due and Default
content:
**Collections terms — ComfortLease Equipment Leases**

Rent unpaid 10 days after the rent due day makes the lease past due and posts one late fee of $15.00 for that rent month. Paying every overdue amount returns the lease to active. Rent unpaid 90 days after its due date terminates the lease for default: the equipment is removed, the removal fee ($295.00) is charged and every unpaid amount remains owed.

Both periods are counted in calendar days after the due date. Rent is due on the 1st of the month.

## Terms by system

| Leased system | Grace period after the due date | Late fee per late rent month | Unpaid period before termination for default |
|---|---|---|---|
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace | 10 calendar days | $15.00 | 90 calendar days |
| ComfortLease Central Air | 10 calendar days | $15.00 | 90 calendar days |
| ComfortLease Heat Pump | 10 calendar days | $15.00 | 90 calendar days |
| ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air | 10 calendar days | $15.00 | 90 calendar days |
| ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System | 10 calendar days | $15.00 | 90 calendar days |
| ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone | 10 calendar days | $15.00 | 90 calendar days |

## Timeline of one rent month's charge

| Point in time | Standing of the lease |
|---|---|
| Due date, the 1st | Rent charged and due |
| Within the 10 calendar days after the due date | Grace period — rent paid now is not late |
| Rent still unpaid once the 10-day grace period has passed | Lease becomes past due; one late fee of $15.00 posts for that rent month |
| Every overdue amount paid | Lease returns to active |
| Rent still unpaid once 90 calendar days after its due date have passed | Lease terminated for default; equipment removed; removal fee charged; every unpaid amount still owed |

## Cases (hypothetical leases)

- Rent due on the 1st is paid on the 8th: paid within the grace period; the lease does not become past due and no late fee posts.
- Rent due on the 1st is still unpaid once the 10-day grace period has passed: the lease becomes past due and one $15.00 late fee posts for that rent month — one fee for that month, not one per day.
- A past due lease on which the lessee then pays every overdue amount: the lease is active again.
- Rent is still unpaid once 90 calendar days after its due date have passed: the lease is terminated for default, the equipment is removed, the $295.00 removal fee is charged, and the unpaid rent, the late fee and the removal fee all remain owed.
